title: New 1835 ride: Women of 1835 Chicago
items: Seven stops from Wolf Point to the fort, each naming a woman a source puts in the town: Catherine Chevalier Robinson, Juliette Kinzie, Mrs. Murphy of the Exchange Coffee House, Mrs. Rufus Brown's boarding house, Eliza Chappel at her school and her church, and Josette LaFramboise Beaubien.
Each stop says why she still matters, from Wilmette's name to the Girl Scouts, and every fact is sourced.
